difference_ledger.changed_after_bytes_encoding: concatenate each output byte whose value differs, in ascending relative-offset order
difference_ledger.changed_before_bytes_encoding: concatenate each source byte whose value differs, in ascending relative-offset order
difference_ledger.changed_offset_encoding: concatenate one unsigned 32-bit little-endian relative span offset for every changed byte, ascending
difference_ledger.changed_run_encoding: coalesce adjacent changed offsets into half-open [start,end) runs, then concatenate unsigned 32-bit little-endian start,end pairs

transport_algorithm: Require mode=patched from the independent native group36 geometry verifier.
Open and pin the retail XISO and changed copied volume by type, size, inode identity, and SHA-256.
Parse XDVDFS and pin the filesystem shape plus vc_53450030/9, vc_53450030/0, and default.xbe extents and hashes.
Read the pinned retail SCNE span and the same pack-relative span from the independently verified changed volume.
Derive the complete changed-byte and changed-run ledger; refuse a no-op.
Exclusively create a layout-identical copy of the retail XISO and pwrite exactly the authorized span.
Read back the span and compare every source/output disc byte, refusing any difference outside the span or any ledger-count mismatch.
Reparse XDVDFS, require the original tree and extents, require exact default.xbe, and require output volume 9 to equal the independently verified changed volume.
Publish a canonical, exclusively created manifest only after all checks pass.
Independently verify from read-only descriptors without importing either writer, re-deriving native geometry, XDVDFS, span, ledger, full-disc difference count, and all claims.
